description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families, categorized by whether the performance of two multilingual BERT models—mBERT and XLM-R—is better, same, or worse (though “worse” is not explicitly shown in the legend, the “same” category is present). The horizontal axis lists the language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “task count,” ranges from 0 to 40 with tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating the number of tasks for each category. Each language family has three bars: a light blue bar for “mBERT,” a dark blue bar for “XLM-R,” and a light green bar for “same.” The “same” category consistently has the highest task count across all language families, with values ranging from approximately 1 to 30. For example, in IE-Baltic, the task counts are approximately 10 for mBERT, 8 for XLM-R, and 8 for “same.” In IE-Romance, the counts are approximately 4 for mBERT, 13 for XLM-R, and 30 for “same.” The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing one bar for each model and the “same” category. The chart does not show any sorting of the bars by height or any visual emphasis such as shading or outlining beyond the standard bar representation.
